cues.en: When working with arithmetic operations in particular multiplication and addition, you often come across
cues.zh: 做算術，尤其乘法、加法，常會遇到，

cues.en: these three properties in algebra: the associative property the commutative property and the distributive property.
cues.zh: 代數的三個性質：結合律、交換律、分配律。

cues.en: In this video I'm going to give you a quick reminder of what these three properties mean and then when
cues.zh: 這段會快速複習三者的意義，再，

cues.en: we switch to Python you will see how to use python as a tool to understand these properties.
cues.zh: 切到 Python，看看如何把它當成理解這些性質的工具。

cues.en: So let's begin with associative, not because it's the most important principle, but because it starts with an A and that's alphabetically the first in this list.
cues.zh: 先看結合律，不是因為最重要，只是 associative 以 A 開頭，字母順序排第一。

cues.en: So the associative rule basically says that you can move parentheses around wherever you want.
cues.zh: 基本上，結合律說可以移動括號的位置。

cues.en: It probably would be easier to remember if they would have called this the parentheses rule instead of the associative rule.
cues.zh: 如果叫「括號規則」，可能比結合律更容易記。

cues.en: But essentially this means that if we have two times the quantity three times four, I can move these
cues.zh: 意思是，如果有 2 乘以括號裡的 3 乘 4，就能移動，

cues.en: parentheses around and put the parentheses around two times three and put four outside the parentheses.
cues.zh: 括號，改成先把 2 乘 3 放括號裡，4 在外面。

cues.en: So these two expressions are the same and that you can see by evaluating them piecewise.
cues.zh: 兩個式子相同，可以分步計算來確認。

cues.en: So three times four is 12 two times three and six.
And then you do this multiplication and this multiplication and you get twenty four in both ways.
cues.zh: 再分別乘，兩種方式都得到 24。

cues.en: Now when you're working through principles in mathematics I find it useful to start with concrete examples, with actual numbers like this.
cues.zh: 理解數學原則時，我喜歡先用具體例子、實際數字。

cues.en: However, it's always good to demonstrate these principles using more abstract mathematical approaches for example using variables, symbolic variables.
cues.zh: 不過，用抽象的數學方式，例如符號變數，展示原則，也很好。

cues.en: And that's because when you have actual numbers like this you might run into some weird special cases that don't actually generalize.
cues.zh: 因為實際數字可能碰上奇怪的特例，無法推廣，

cues.en: For example, if one of these numbers was a zero then the result is going to be zero equals zero.
cues.zh: 例如有一個數字是 0，結果就會是 0 等於 0，

cues.en: Even if the associative rule weren't true.
cues.zh: 即使結合律不成立也是如此。

cues.en: So we want to make sure that this associative rule works and other principles in mathematics will work not just for these particular numbers but for any numbers in general.
cues.zh: 因此要確定，結合律和其他原則，不只對這幾個數字，而是一般任何數字都成立。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So therefore you replace the numbers with letters.
cues.zh: 把數字換成字母，

cues.en: And of course in this case you arrive at the same conclusion.
cues.zh: 這個例子當然得到相同結論。

cues.en: So the associative rule is valid for algebra when these letters are corresponding to individual numbers.
cues.zh: 字母代表個別數字時，代數的結合律成立。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that was the associative rule.
cues.zh: 以上是結合律，

cues.en: It probably should be called the parentheses rule but whatever.
cues.zh: 也許應該叫括號規則，算了。

cues.en: Now we get to the commutative rule, and this basically means that you can swap the order of multiplication.
cues.zh: 接著是交換律，基本上可以交換乘法順序，

cues.en: So A times B is the same thing as B times A. The way that I remember the commutative rule or the commutative property is like you're going to a commute to work.
cues.zh: a 乘 b 等於 b 乘 a。我用 commute，也就是通勤，來記 commutative，

cues.en: So here you are at home and then you commute to work, and then you're at work and you can be home.
cues.zh: 你在家，通勤到工作地點，接著從工作地點回家。

cues.en: I don't know if that's a good way to remember this property but that's what I use.
cues.zh: 不知道是不是好口訣，但我這樣記。

cues.en: And this also applies to more than two individual numbers so for example A times B times C equals
cues.zh: 不只兩個數字也適用，例如 a 乘 b 乘 c，等於，

cues.en: B times A time C equals C times A times B. Basically you can swap around the order and as long as you're still doing multiplication, as long as these letters correspond to individual numbers, it's no problem
cues.zh: b 乘 a 乘 c，也等於 c 乘 a 乘 b。只要仍然是乘法，而且字母代表個別數字，就能任意換順序，完全，

cues.en: whatsoever.
cues.zh: 沒有問題。

cues.en: Finally, we get to the distributive rule and that's where if you have some number that's multiplying
cues.zh: 最後分配律。如果某個數字乘上，

cues.en: the sum or the difference of two numbers in parentheses then you can distribute what's outside the parenthesis to what's to each of the terms inside the parentheses.
cues.zh: 括號裡兩個數字的和或差，就能把外面的數字，分別乘進括號內每一項。

cues.en: So here x times the quantity y plus z equals X times Y plus X times z.
cues.zh: 例如 x 乘以括號裡的 y 加 z，等於 xy 加 xz。
